name: Hero Drop
summary:
Dash. Grind. Drop in.

Hero Drop is a free-to-play team shooter made for VR movement. Aim your dash through the air, grind rails across the map and land the shot nobody saw coming. Matches are 5v5 on dedicated servers, and bots take every empty seat, so there is always a match to drop into.

🚀 MOVE LIKE NOBODY ELSE
Up to five dash charges, rails to grind, sprint, crouch and real room-scale leaning. Snap or smooth turning and an adjustable vignette let you tune the comfort.

🔫 PICK YOUR WEAPON
Charged pist
